profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Google - Core/AI Networking Automation
profile.summary:
I am currently a senior software engineer working on core/AI network automation at Google.  I am a senior software engineer with 9+ years experience in networking infrastructure. While at Google, I have architected large-scale systems that process data from Google’s networks in real time, to improve automation and reliability.  I have also architected systems that authoritatively model and present a unified view of Google's core/AI networks, to coordinate higher level network automation.

Key Skills:

- Subject Matter Expertise: Core/AI Networking Architecture, Computer Networks, Security and Authorization Systems, Databases, Distributed Systems, System Health Monitoring and Alerting

- Team Leadership Skills: Project Management, Design Planning and Scoping, Sprint Planning, Mentoring and Career Growth
